description: This file defines a custom RecyclerView.ItemDecoration that manages sticky section headers in a RecyclerView, ensuring headers remain visible and 'stick' at the top during scrolling. It provides mechanisms for creating, binding, and measuring header views, and handles the drawing and translation to achieve sticky behavior.

classes.name: NotificationsSectionHeaderDecoration
classes.description: A RecyclerView.ItemDecoration that renders sticky headers for sections, creating a pinned header that updates as the user scrolls through sections.

methods.name: onDrawOver
methods.description: Draws the header over the RecyclerView items, translating the header when a new section header pushes the current one.

methods.name: getHeaderView
methods.description: Creates, binds, measures, and layouts the header view for a given position.

methods.name: findHeaderPositionForItem
methods.description: Finds the position of the header for a given item position by traversing backward.

methods.name: getChildInContact
methods.description: Returns the child view in contact with the given contact point.
